prompt: Which step turns a model's scores for the next token into probabilities?

choices.text: Temperature, which divides the scores by a number
choices.why: Temperature reshapes the scores; softmax makes them probabilities.

choices.text: The seed that the harness passes with every call
choices.why: The seed decides a draw, not the probabilities it draws from.

choices.text: Softmax
choices.why: Right: raise e to each score and divide by the total.

choices.text: Top-k, which keeps the highest-scoring candidates
choices.why: Top-k cuts candidates after the probabilities exist.

prompt: Adding 10 to every score leaves softmax's probabilities exactly as they were. Why?

choices.text: Softmax rounds every score to the nearest whole number
choices.why: Nothing is rounded.

choices.text: Scores above zero are clipped back to zero first
choices.why: Nothing is clipped; `distribution()` subtracts the top score to keep the numbers small, which is the same fact.

choices.text: A score of 10 is too large for the model to produce
choices.why: The size of the score is not the point.

choices.text: Softmax compares only the differences between scores
choices.why: Right: e to the 10 cancels out of every ratio.
